## Supplemental figures are included here

```{r}
## PHAGES
# ===================== HELPERS =====================
extract_clean_genus <- function(x){
  g <- ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "g__"),
              str_replace(x, ".*g__", ""),
              NA_character_)
  g <- sub("_[A-Z]$", "", g)
  dplyr::recode(g,
    "Kleibsella" = "Klebsiella",
    "Gemminger"  = "Gemmiger",
    .default = g
  )
}

base_prepare <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Group = dplyr::case_when(
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 0.25 ~ "1 week",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 1    ~ "1 month",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 6    ~ "6 months",
        mother_infant == "infant" & timepoint_months == 12   ~ "12 months",
        mother_infant == "mother" & bodysite == "stool"      ~ "mothers",
        bodysite == "breastmilk"                             ~ "milk",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Genus_raw = extract_clean_genus(Host.genus),
      Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus_raw) | Genus_raw == "" | Genus_raw == "NA",
                     "Unclassified", Genus_raw)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
    filter(CPM > 0)
}

ensure_palette <- function(levels_vec, pal){
  miss <- setdiff(levels_vec, names(pal))
  if(length(miss) > 0){
    pal <- c(pal, setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(miss)), miss))
  }
  pal
}

# ===================== PLOT =====================
plot_topN_with_other_unclassified <- function(
  df,
  top_n = 10,
  top_from = c("all","stool"),
  title = "Average proportional distribution of predicted host genera (CPM)"
){
  top_from <- match.arg(top_from)

  dat <- base_prepare(df)

  cpm_by_sample_genus <- dat %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Genus) %>%
    summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")

  # ---- define TOP N (excluye Unclassified de la competición) ----
  if(top_from == "stool"){
    cpm_for_top <- dat %>%
      filter(bodysite == "stool") %>%
      group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
      summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    cpm_for_top <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
      select(Sample, Genus, total_CPM)
  }

  top_genera <- cpm_for_top %>%
    filter(Genus != "Unclassified") %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(global_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(global_CPM)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(Genus)

  df_collapsed <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
    mutate(
      Genus_collapsed = dplyr::case_when(
        Genus == "Unclassified"       ~ "Unclassified",
        Genus %in% top_genera         ~ Genus,
        TRUE                          ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
    summarise(total_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop")

  # Proporción REAL por muestra (incluyendo Other + Unclassified)
  prop <- df_collapsed %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = total_CPM / sum(total_CPM)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Media por grupo (manteniendo proporciones reales)
  group_mean <- prop %>%
    group_by(Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion), .groups = "drop")

  group_levels <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")
  group_mean$Group <- factor(group_mean$Group, levels = group_levels)

  # Orden de la leyenda: top (por abundancia) + Other + Unclassified
  genus_order <- c(
    top_genera[top_genera %in% group_mean$Genus_collapsed],
    "Other", "Unclassified"
  )
  group_mean$Genus_collapsed <- factor(group_mean$Genus_collapsed, levels = genus_order)

  pal <- ensure_palette(levels(group_mean$Genus_collapsed), user_palette)
  pal["Other"] <- "grey70"
  pal["Unclassified"] <- "grey30"

ggplot(group_mean, aes(Group, Mean_Proportion, fill = Genus_collapsed)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = "Predicted host genus", title = title) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

}
```

```{r}
plot_topN_with_other_unclassified <- function(
  df,
  top_n = 10,
  top_from = c("all","stool"),
  title = "Predicted host genera (CPM): top10 + Other + Unclassified"
){
  top_from <- match.arg(top_from)

  dat <- base_prepare(df)

  cpm_by_sample_genus <- dat %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Genus) %>%
    summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")

  # ---- define TOP N (excluye Unclassified de la competición) ----
  if(top_from == "stool"){
    cpm_for_top <- dat %>%
      filter(bodysite == "stool") %>%
      group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
      summarise(total_CPM = sum(CPM), .groups = "drop")
  } else {
    cpm_for_top <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
      select(Sample, Genus, total_CPM)
  }

  top_genera <- cpm_for_top %>%
    filter(Genus != "Unclassified") %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(global_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(global_CPM)) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
    pull(Genus)

  # Colapsar a: top + Other + Unclassified
  df_collapsed <- cpm_by_sample_genus %>%
    mutate(
      Genus_collapsed = dplyr::case_when(
        Genus == "Unclassified" ~ "Unclassified",
        Genus %in% top_genera   ~ Genus,
        TRUE                    ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
    summarise(total_CPM = sum(total_CPM), .groups = "drop")

  # >>> CLAVE: completar ceros para que cada Sample tenga todas las categorías
  all_levels <- c(top_genera, "Other", "Unclassified")
  df_collapsed <- df_collapsed %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
    tidyr::complete(Genus_collapsed = all_levels, fill = list(total_CPM = 0)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Proporciones por muestra (0–100)
  prop <- df_collapsed %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = 100 * total_CPM / sum(total_CPM)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Media por grupo (ahora sí suma 100)
  group_mean <- prop %>%
    group_by(Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion), .groups = "drop")

  group_levels <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")
  group_mean$Group <- factor(group_mean$Group, levels = group_levels)

  group_mean$Genus_collapsed <- factor(group_mean$Genus_collapsed, levels = all_levels)

  pal <- ensure_palette(levels(group_mean$Genus_collapsed), user_palette)
  pal["Other"] <- "grey70"
  pal["Unclassified"] <- "grey30"

  ggplot(group_mean, aes(Group, Mean_Proportion, fill = Genus_collapsed)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = "Predicted host genus", title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}
```

  df,
  top_n = 10,
  top_from = "stool",
  title = "Predicted host genera (CPM): top10 + Other + Unclassified"
)

```{r}
# ===================== PANEL 3 (BACTERIA for PHAGE top10 host genera)
#          - incluye TODA la taxonomía vía Other + Unclassified
#          - incluye milk si existe en MMC3
#          - lista top10 definida desde PHAGES (stool only)
# =====================

# 1) Top10 host genera definidos desde PHAGES (stool only)
top10_phage_genera <- phage_stool %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(global = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(global)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(Genus)

# 2) Preparar bacterias (MMC3)
bact_for_phageTop10_full <- bact_genus %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    Group,
    Genus_raw = Genus,
    Rel_abund_bact = Rel_abund_bact
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Rel_abund_bact), Rel_abund_bact > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_clean = ifelse(is.na(Genus_raw) | Genus_raw == "" | Genus_raw == "NA",
                         "Unclassified", Genus_raw),
    Genus_collapsed = case_when(
      Genus_clean == "Unclassified"       ~ "Unclassified",
      Genus_clean %in% top10_phage_genera ~ Genus_clean,
      TRUE                                ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
  summarise(Rel_abund_bact = sum(Rel_abund_bact, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3) Plot (0–100, proporciones reales; mean incluye ceros via complete)
plot_bact_top10phage_with_other_unclassified <- function(df, title, fill_title, palette, top_levels){

  all_levels <- c(top_levels, "Other", "Unclassified")

  dat0 <- df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Group) %>%
    tidyr::complete(Genus_collapsed = all_levels, fill = list(Rel_abund_bact = 0)) %>%
    ungroup()

  prop <- dat0 %>%
    group_by(Sample) %>%
    mutate(Proportion = 100 * Rel_abund_bact / sum(Rel_abund_bact)) %>%
    ungroup()

  group_mean <- prop %>%
    group_by(Group, Genus_collapsed) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion), .groups = "drop")

  group_levels2 <- c("1 week","1 month","6 months","12 months","mothers","milk")
  group_mean$Group <- factor(group_mean$Group, levels = group_levels2)
  group_mean$Genus_collapsed <- factor(group_mean$Genus_collapsed, levels = all_levels)

  pal <- ensure_palette(levels(group_mean$Genus_collapsed), palette)
  pal["Other"] <- "grey70"
  pal["Unclassified"] <- "grey30"

  ggplot(group_mean, aes(Group, Mean_Proportion, fill = Genus_collapsed)) +
    geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)", fill = fill_title, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
}

p_bact_for_phageTop10_full <- plot_bact_top10phage_with_other_unclassified(
  df = bact_for_phageTop10_full,
  title = "Bacteria (MMC3) for phage top-10 host genera — incl. milk (Other + Unclassified)",
  fill_title = "Bacterial genus",
  palette = user_palette_pastel,
  top_levels = top10_phage_genera
)

print(p_bact_for_phageTop10_full)

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "BACT_for_PHAGE_top10_PLUS_OTHER_PLUS_UNCLASSIFIED_inclMilk.png"),
       p_bact_for_phageTop10_full, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "BACT_for_PHAGE_top10_PLUS_OTHER_PLUS_UNCLASSIFIED_inclMilk.pdf"),
       p_bact_for_phageTop10_full, width = 11, height = 10, bg = "white")
```
